subject: Feature flag platform: sourcing & consolidation plan
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Feature flag platform: sourcing & consolidation plan

Team —

We have two major platform renewals coming up this spring: our LaunchDarkly estate (prod+staging) and a smaller Optimizely account used by Growth. Before we get into supplier conversations I want a concise recommendation and risks/costs for consolidating to a single provider vs maintaining both. Key asks:

- One-paragraph recommendation (Consolidate to LD / Keep both / Consolidate to Opti)
- 3-year TCO comparison (licenses + migration + training) — rough numbers are OK
- Operational risk summary (tools, integrations, SSO/KMS, KV cache, rollout primitives we rely on)
- Migration plan (if consolidation): time estimate, owners, minimal cutover approach

Can Marissa and Markus take the lead on vendor proposals and a migration feasibility check? Lauren — finance review for any PO/commit implications. Karthik — please coordinate procurement checklist and legal redlines.

Want this short brief by EOD Friday so we can decide whether to enter negotiations or pursue a multi-vendor play.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai] [ext: 214]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Hub <procurement@vendorservices.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Feature flag platform: sourcing & consolidation plan

Jordan —

Attaching the two vendor proposals we received this week (LD + Optimizely) and a draft cost model. High level notes:

- LaunchDarkly: competitive renewal pricing if we commit 24 months for our current footprint. They include migration credits (one week engineer support) and a hands-on onboarding package for $25k. SLA language looks standard; they offered a defined escalation path and playbook for big releases.

- Optimizely: higher base seat/license cost for experimentation features, but includes native experimentation analytics and a lighter data export SLA. Migration to Optimizely would require a short rewrite of our rollout hooks (feature-flag SDK adapters) and has a slightly longer timeline.

My read: LD is lower friction for ops (already in prod across most services) and has better support for the traffic shapes we run. Optimizely gives richer experimentation primitives that Growth likes, but would be a heavier lift.

Attachments: LD_proposal_Q1_2027.pdf, Opti_enterprise_quote_2027.pdf, ff_consolidation_cost_model_3yr.xlsx

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of GTM Programs — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Sam Ross <sam.ross@launchdarkly.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Feature flag platform: sourcing & consolidation plan

Hi Jordan & Marissa —

Thanks for sharing the context. A couple of quick items from our side:

- Pricing: we can offer a 15% discount off list for a 24-month commitment covering your current prod+staging footprint, or a flex-commit (12mo with a 6mo extension option).
- Migration assistance: we propose a 3-week migration engagement (two LD engineers + one solutions architect) to cover export/import of flags, key SDK updates, and canary rollout support. We can include the first week at no charge if a 24-month contract is signed by March 31.
- Professional services: extended SSOs and audit log retention add-ons are available — I included a short SOW in the attached.

I've attached LD_proposal_Q1_2027.pdf and a redline-friendly SOW stub. Happy to jump on a 30-min call with your infra team next week to review the migration plan.

Best,
Sam Ross
Sales Director, Strategic Accounts — LaunchDarkly
[Attachment: LD_proposal_Q1_2027.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Feature flag platform: sourcing & consolidation plan

On Wed, Feb 17, 2027 at 10:45 AM Sam Ross <sam.ross@launchdarkly.com> wrote:
> Thanks for sharing the context. A couple of quick items from our side:
> - Pricing: we can offer a 15% discount off list for a 24-month commitment...

Quick technical readout after reviewing the proposals and running a short compatibility check:

- Integrations: LD covers everything we use today (Kafka event hooks, Rollout API, SSO via Okta, and the feature flag proxy). Minimal SDK changes required for services that already use the LD SDK.
- Experimentation: Optimizely's A/B analytics are nice, but we already capture most experiment telemetry in our observability pipeline; bridging is doable via existing event exports.
- Risk: biggest risk for consolidation is Growth's reliance on Optimizely-specific analytics dashboards. Proposal: keep Optimizely for Growth for 6 months as a migration runway, but consolidate platform-owned services on LaunchDarkly now. This reduces license overlap while giving Growth time to port experiments.
- Timeline: pilot consolidation for non-Growth services over 6-8 weeks (flag sync + SDK upgrades + canary). Full consolidation (including Growth) could be phased over 3-4 quarters.

I'll draft a short migration runbook if we proceed. Recommend we accept LD's 24-month pricing with the migration credit and set a limited-scope pilot starting April.

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Infrastructure — Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Feature flag platform: sourcing & consolidation plan

Team — quick summary and next steps:

Decision: Move forward with a targeted consolidation onto LaunchDarkly for platform-owned services. We will:

1) Sign a 24-month commitment with LaunchDarkly to capture the migration credit (Finance to review final PO numbers).
2) Keep Optimizely active for Growth for up to 6 months to allow experiment porting; Growth will be responsible for migrating their analytics dashboards.
3) Run a pilot starting the week of April 4 for 6-8 weeks covering 5 services (non-Growth) with Markus as tech lead.
4) Procurement (Karthik) to lead contract negotiations and secure the March 31 discount timeline with Sam.
5) Marissa to coordinate vendor kickoff and professional services SOW; Jordan will approve commercial terms.

Action items: Lauren — can you confirm PO cadence and whether we can front-load professional services as CapEx vs OpEx? Karthik — please open the procurement ticket and attach the LD SOW. Markus & Marissa — sync on the runbook draft next week; schedule a 30-min migration alignment with Sam (LD) and infra.

Thanks everyone — this feels like the right balance of risk and cost.

Jordan Blake
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai]
